products.title: Bench - Pedro Indoor - By Roberto Lazzeroni
products.description_html: Linear with a strong core and a gentle seat, the Passepartout bench, born from Federico Peri's timeless design, merges elegance, adaptability, and comfort in an iconic model that enriches any setting with style. A design with a perfect balance that never goes out of style and stands out for the rounded lines and the leather that surrounds the long upholstered seat, inviting you to rest and relax. The base of the bench, solid and essential, is available in burnished metal versions with details in satin brass or in brass with bronzing oxidation and satin finish.

products.title: Bench - Dharma - By Studiopepe
products.description_html: Dharma is a collection of elegant and unusual furniture items whose designs - the product of a collaboration with Studiopepe - go beyond the concept of modern. Their unconventional and evocative appearance totally sets them apart from other Baxter solutions. The stools, armchairs, benches and loungers of the collection look like sculptures, polished yet informal, statuesque yet dynamic, with painted surfaces that conceal a core composed of natural materials. Surprisingly comfortable and enveloping thanks to weatherproof cushions and mattresses, these seats can be combined or used individually in both the living room and the garden.

products.title: Bench - Regis - By Vincent Van Duysen
products.description_html:
The Regis is the perfect representation of practicality and versatility. Whether used as additional seating or as a footrest, this elegant and functional stool effortlessly transforms into a pouf. Regis adds a touch of elegance to any space, creating a warm and inviting environment for guests to relax at their leisure.

Crafted with a burnished metal base of three polished legs and circular frame, Regis exudes understated sophistication. The seat, custom upholstered in luxurious vegetable-tanned leather or carefully curated textiles by designer Marta Ferri, ensures both comfort and style. Vincent Van Duysen describes Regis as "a timeless piece with enduring appeal," reflecting its ability to transcend trends and complement any interior with grace.

Measuring 48cm in diameter and 45cm in height, Regis blends form and versatility. Its circular yet structured design allows it to seamlessly integrate into various settings, serving as a connecting element between pieces like the Augusto and Lucio sofas from the 2024 collection.

products.title: Bench - Aldgate - By Rodolfo Dordoni
products.description_html:
Aldgate Bench is designed to mirror the sophistication and unparalleled comfort of the Aldgate Bed by Rodolfo Dordoni. The bench features a removable outer cover crafted from bonded velveteen cotton blend and stands upon sleek, aluminum feet. Rodolfo Dordoni’s Aldgate Bench creates a cohesive and harmonious atmosphere in the bedroom.

In keeping with the Aldgate inspiration of soft lines and a subtle finish, the bench is designed as an isolated element that radiates autonomy and self-sufficiency. Crafted with meticulous attention to detail, the Aldgate Bench seamlessly integrates with various bedroom settings, offering a versatile and stylish seating solution.

DIMENSIONS : 

  • (W): 163 cm 

  • (D): 53 cm

  • (H): 36 cm

products.title: Bench - Azul Bench - By Nicola Gallizia
products.description_html:
Azul Bench expresses the value of craftsmanship that is evident in the processing of raw materials of the highest quality, dictated by seams performed with care and passion.

Powder coated steel structure completely covered in regenerated hide-leather in the colors of the Molteni&C range.

A single functional measure for all sizes of the Azul bed.

DIMENSIONS : 

  • (W): 166 cm 

  • (D): 41 cm

  • (H): 43 cm

products.title: Bench - Tibeau - By GamFratesi
products.description_html:
The Tibeau bench by GamFratesi is a natural extension of the Tibeau bed, reinforcing its sculptural presence while adding functionality and versatility to the sleeping space. Designed with the same commitment to craftsmanship and material integrity, the bench embodies a dialogue between strength and softness, form and function.

Echoing the bold architectural language of the Tibeau bed, the bench features a solid wood frame, defined by clean lines and geometric precision. Its structure references historical and brutalist influences, balancing a sense of permanence with refined detailing. A generously padded seat cushion introduces an inviting contrast, softening the piece while ensuring comfort and practicality.

Perfectly aligned with the Tibeau bed’s aesthetic, the bench serves as a seamless companion, offering additional seating or a convenient surface within the bedroom. Whether placed alongside the bed or as a standalone accent, it upholds the timeless architectural presence that defines Molteni&C’s approach to contemporary living.

DIMENSIONS : 

  • (W): 160 cm 

  • (D): 41.1 cm

  • (H): 32.5 cm

products.title: Bench - Ultrasound
products.description_html: Padded bench upholstered in leather or fabric. Plywood frame and seat consisting of a polyurethane cushion and acrylic skirt, with a quilted top. Seat can be opened to reveal an internal storage compartment, fully lined in microfiber. Padded rolls included.

products.title: Bench - Ripley
products.description_html: Padded bench with leather or fabric cushion, with a wooden frame covered in leather or fabric, matching the Ripley bed. Internal structure made of solid wood blocks and plywood, internal compartment.

products.title: Bench - Princess
products.description_html: Bench upholstered in leather or fabric. Structure in solid wood carved and upholstered in leather with conic-shaped feet with satinized metal tips. Seat with central part in leather decorated with pleated motive and lateral parts in leather or fabric. Leathers available: Nabuk, Soft, Malta, Sherwood, Classic. Satinized metal parts available in the metal finishing selection.

products.title: Bench - Leonardo
products.description_html: Upholstered bench in leather or fabric. Plywood frame and seat made of a polyurethane cushion and acrylic wadding, with top quilting. Seat opens up with an internal storage compartment, fully lined with microfiber. Padded rolls included.

products.title: Bench - Kloster
products.description_html: Fixed fitness bench, 316 polished stainless steel support structure with curved bottom and column legs with concave and convex surfaces. Polyurethane seat with washable and moisture-resistant leather or fabric upholstery (outdoor upholstery), with upholstered surface quilting in diamond pattern.

products.title: Bench - Jorge
products.description_html: Upholstered chest covered in leather or fabric, with opening seat available in leather or woven fabric. Internal wooden frame, base and seat profile in brushed stainless steel. Internal compartment in lacquered wood. Metal parts available in the metal finishing selection.

products.title: Bench - Ca' Foscari
products.description_html: Bench with fixed upholstery in leather or fabric, structure in plywood and solid wood with elastic webbing belts. Seat padded with differentiated-density polyurethane foam, Memory Foam® and feather. Shaped base in wood covered in curved stainless steel with concave profile and shiny finish. Metal parts are available in the metal finishing selection.

products.title: Bench - Embrace
products.description_html: Padded bench, upholstered in leather or fabric. Structure in plywood and solid wood. Base in MDF covered in satin steel. Padding in polyurethane and acrylic wadding with quilted cushion (cannetè weave) and smooth sides. The base is available in the selection of metallic finishes.

products.title: Bench - Ekos
products.description_html: Upholstered bench with linear seat in leather or fabric, base covered in curved polished stainless steel, with concave-shaped solid marble side elements. Metal parts available in the metal finishing selection. The seat is also available in the “quilted” version in leather with embroidery with a slightly padded, foliage design.

products.title: Bench - Le Comte
products.description_html: Upholstered bench in leather or fabric. Plywood frame and seat made of a polyurethane cushion and acrylic wadding. Two contrasting fabric or leather frames characterise the upholstery. Aluminum legs. Metal parts available in gold or chrome finishes.

products.title: Bench - Blondie
products.description_html: Structure in solid wood and shaped poplar plywood, padding in polyurethane foam with different densities and elastic straps springing system. Seat padded in Memory Foam® internally upholstered in leather or fabric, quilted portions padded one-by-one. External upholstery in leather or smooth fabric, pipings in leather. Base and feet in beech solid wood covered in veneer with corner elements and feet pads in satinized stainless steel. Structure and feet available in the veneer finishing selections; metal parts available in the satinized metal finishing selection.

products.title: Bench - Aubade
products.description_html: Bench with internal structure in solid wood and fir plywood, density polyurethane padding differentiate. Upholstery in leather or fabric. Tapes decorative rivets in leather or fabric and leather piping with friezes in satin aluminum and stainless steel.
